data.name: Home.Intro

data.name: About.Body
data.value: WinForge builds customized Windows images from an offline working copy. The original ISO is never modified; all changes target an isolated, mounted working image.

data.name: Source.SelectEditionHint
data.value: Select an edition to target it for customization.

data.name: Source.WorkspaceNote
data.value: The workspace references the original ISO and the image's path inside it — the temporary mount drive is never stored or shown.

data.name: Source.IsolatedNote
data.value: WinForge works on an isolated copy of the selected Windows edition. The original ISO and install.wim/install.esd are never modified.

data.name: Prepare.Note
data.value: The original ISO and install.wim/install.esd are never modified. The working image is an isolated copy you can discard at any time.

data.name: Customize.ServiceUnknownReason

data.name: Customize.SettingProtectedReason

data.name: Review.Intro
data.value: Review the declarative plan assembled from the Customize step. Execution only begins when you press Apply — never from a checkbox change.

data.name: Review.ValidatePassed
data.value: Plan validation passed. Changes can now be applied.

data.name: Review.ValidateFailed

data.name: Review.Note
data.value: Applying changes the isolated, mounted working image only. The image remains mounted; commit/discard and image export happen in later steps.

data.name: Review.ApplyIntro
data.value: Press Apply to write the validated plan to the mounted working image.

data.name: Build.Intro

data.name: Components.Intro
data.value: Discover removable items from the mounted working image. Selections build a declarative plan — nothing is changed until you apply it from the Plan page.

data.name: Components.PackagesHint
data.value: Only optional feature/capability packages are offered for removal. Language, core, driver, and servicing packages are protected.

data.name: Components.ServicesHint
data.value: Selecting a service disables it in the offline image. Protected services cannot be changed here.

data.name: Privacy.Intro
data.value: Curated, documented, offline-applicable privacy toggles. These change the offline image's machine-policy registry only — never a signed-in user, cloud, or account policy.

data.name: System.Intro
data.value: Safe, offline service and machine-policy changes only. No boot configuration, partitioning, drivers, kernel patches, or blanket security disabling.

data.name: ComponentIntelligence.Intro
data.value: Understand what each Windows component does, whether you need it, and what happens if you remove it. Read-only analysis prototype.

data.name: ComponentIntelligence.NoImage
data.value: Mount a working image to inventory real components. Showing the curated catalog only.

data.name: ComponentIntelligence.Summary
data.value: Discovered {0} AppX, {1} capabilities, {2} optional features, {3} packages.

data.name: Knowledge.CatalogOnly
data.value: Catalog entry (not detected in this image)

data.name: Knowledge.EmptyNoCurated

data.name: Comp.Weather.Short
data.value: Microsoft's weather application, provisioned for new users.

data.name: Comp.Weather.Long
data.value: The built-in Weather app. Its removal only affects the app itself; it does not disable Windows networking or any weather APIs used by the OS.

data.name: Comp.Weather.KeepIf
data.value: You actively use the Microsoft Weather app.

data.name: Comp.Weather.RemoveIf
data.value: You never check weather in the built-in app and use a website or another app.

data.name: Comp.Weather.Impact
data.value: The Weather app is unavailable for newly created users. No core Windows feature is removed.

data.name: Comp.Clipchamp.Short
data.value: Microsoft's video editor, provisioned for new users.

data.name: Comp.Clipchamp.Long
data.value: A consumer video-editing and capture tool. Removal only affects the app; it is reinstallable from the Microsoft Store.

data.name: Comp.Clipchamp.KeepIf
data.value: You edit or record video with Clipchamp.

data.name: Comp.Clipchamp.RemoveIf
data.value: You never use Clipchamp and prefer another editor.

data.name: Comp.Clipchamp.Impact
data.value: Clipchamp is unavailable for new users. No system video capability is removed.

data.name: Comp.GetHelp.Long
data.value: Launches help articles and can open a support contact flow. Removing it does not disable Windows troubleshooting or Settings search.

data.name: Comp.GetHelp.KeepIf
data.value: You use the built-in Help app to reach Microsoft support.

data.name: Comp.GetHelp.RemoveIf
data.value: You never use the Help app and search the web instead.

data.name: Comp.GetHelp.Impact
data.value: The Get Help app is unavailable. Windows Settings and troubleshooting remain.

data.name: Comp.XboxApp.Short
data.value: Xbox app plus gaming overlays, providers and services.

data.name: Comp.XboxApp.Long
data.value: The Xbox app, game overlay and identity provider, plus the Gaming Services runtime used by Xbox Game Pass and PC games. Several raw Xbox identities collapse into this one logical component. Removal is safe for users who do not game on Xbox.

data.name: Comp.XboxApp.KeepIf
data.value: You use Xbox Game Pass or play Xbox titles on this PC.

data.name: Comp.XboxApp.RemoveIf
data.value: You do not use Xbox apps or PC gaming.

data.name: Comp.XboxApp.Impact
data.value: Xbox app, game overlay, Xbox sign-in provider and Gaming Services are removed. Non-gaming apps are unaffected.

data.name: Comp.XboxApp.Prov0
data.value: Xbox / Gaming bundles the Xbox app, game overlay, identity provider and Gaming Services runtime.

data.name: Comp.XboxApp.Prov1
data.value: Optional to remove for users who do not use Xbox / PC gaming.

data.name: Comp.XboxApp.Scen.Gaming
data.value: Kept because you selected a Gaming profile; Xbox Game Pass and PC gaming depend on it.

data.name: Comp.Photos.Long
data.value: The default Photos app. Many users rely on it as the shell image viewer; removing it leaves the OS without a built-in photo viewer (files still open via other apps).

data.name: Comp.Photos.KeepIf
data.value: You use Photos as your default image viewer.

data.name: Comp.Photos.RemoveIf
data.value: You use a different photo app and never the built-in one.

data.name: Comp.Photos.Impact
data.value: The built-in Photos viewer is removed. Image files remain on disk and open via other apps.

data.name: Comp.FeedbackHub.Long
data.value: Used to send feedback to Microsoft. Not required by any Windows feature.

data.name: Comp.FeedbackHub.KeepIf
data.value: You submit feedback to Microsoft through the app.

data.name: Comp.FeedbackHub.RemoveIf
data.value: You never use the Feedback Hub.

data.name: Comp.FeedbackHub.Impact
data.value: The Feedback Hub is unavailable. No Windows function depends on it.

data.name: Comp.Maps.Long
data.value: The built-in Maps app. Offline maps and location APIs used by other apps are separate Windows features and are NOT removed with this app.

data.name: Comp.Maps.KeepIf
data.value: You use the built-in Maps app for navigation.

data.name: Comp.Maps.RemoveIf
data.value: You use a web map or another maps app.

data.name: Comp.Maps.Impact
data.value: The Maps app is removed. Location services and other apps' maps still work.

data.name: Comp.PhoneLink.Short
data.value: Microsoft's app that links your phone to your PC.

data.name: Comp.PhoneLink.Long
data.value: Phone Link (Your Phone) mirrors notifications, photos and calls from an Android phone. Removing it only affects that integration.

data.name: Comp.PhoneLink.KeepIf
data.value: You use Phone Link to connect an Android phone.

data.name: Comp.PhoneLink.RemoveIf
data.value: You do not link a phone to this PC.

data.name: Comp.PhoneLink.Impact
data.value: Phone Link integration is removed. Your phone and PC otherwise work normally.

data.name: Comp.Solitaire.Long
data.value: A casual games bundle. Purely optional entertainment; no system dependency.

data.name: Comp.Solitaire.KeepIf
data.value: You play the built-in Solitaire or casual games.

data.name: Comp.Solitaire.RemoveIf
data.value: You never play the bundled games.

data.name: Comp.Solitaire.Impact
data.value: The Solitaire Collection is removed. No Windows function depends on it.

data.name: Comp.Teams.Short
data.value: Microsoft's consumer/work chat and meetings app.

data.name: Comp.Teams.Long
data.value: Teams for personal and work communication. Files shared in Teams are stored in OneDrive; the two are associated (see the dependency note) but Teams works without OneDrive.

data.name: Comp.Teams.KeepIf
data.value: You use Teams for chat, calls or meetings.

data.name: Comp.Teams.RemoveIf
data.value: You do not use Teams on this PC.

data.name: Comp.Teams.Impact
data.value: The Teams app is removed. Web Teams still works in a browser.

data.name: Comp.OneDrive.Long
data.value: OneDrive syncs your files to the cloud and is deeply integrated with Office and the shell. Removal is possible but can affect file sync and Teams/Office storage; treat as Conditional and verify before removing.

data.name: Comp.OneDrive.KeepIf
data.value: You rely on OneDrive to sync or back up your files.

data.name: Comp.OneDrive.RemoveIf
data.value: You do not use cloud file sync and keep files local only.

data.name: Comp.OneDrive.Impact
data.value: OneDrive sync stops; locally cached files may need re-downloading. Office and shell integration are reduced.

data.name: Comp.AV1VideoExtension.Short
data.value: Codec that lets Windows play AV1-encoded video.

data.name: Comp.AV1VideoExtension.Long
data.value: Provides AV1 hardware/software playback. Optional: most content still plays via other codecs; removing it only affects AV1 playback.

data.name: Comp.AV1VideoExtension.KeepIf
data.value: You watch AV1 video or need maximum codec coverage.

data.name: Comp.AV1VideoExtension.RemoveIf
data.value: You do not play AV1 video and want to free space.

data.name: Comp.AV1VideoExtension.Impact
data.value: AV1 video will not play (other formats are unaffected).

data.name: Comp.AV1VideoExtension.Prov0
data.value: AV1 Video Extension provides AV1 media playback support.

data.name: Comp.AV1VideoExtension.Prov1
data.value: Optional to remove for users who do not play AV1 video.

data.name: Comp.AVCEncoderVideoExtension.Short
data.value: Codec that lets apps encode H.264/AVC video.

data.name: Comp.AVCEncoderVideoExtension.Long
data.value: Provides AVC encoding used by some capture/share apps. Optional: removing it only affects apps that depend on this specific encoder.

data.name: Comp.AVCEncoderVideoExtension.KeepIf
data.value: You use screen/capture apps that encode AVC video.

data.name: Comp.AVCEncoderVideoExtension.RemoveIf
data.value: You do not use AVC encoding apps.

data.name: Comp.AVCEncoderVideoExtension.Impact
data.value: Apps relying on the AVC encoder may lose export options.

data.name: Comp.AVCEncoderVideoExtension.Prov0
data.value: AVC Encoder Video Extension provides H.264/AVC video encoding.

data.name: Comp.AVCEncoderVideoExtension.Prov1
data.value: Optional to remove for users who do not encode AVC video.

data.name: Comp.BingNews.Long
data.value: A consumer news reader. Purely optional; no Windows feature depends on it.

data.name: Comp.BingNews.KeepIf
data.value: You read news in the built-in app.

data.name: Comp.BingNews.RemoveIf
data.value: You never use the News app.

data.name: Comp.BingNews.Impact
data.value: The News app is unavailable. Web news still works.

data.name: Comp.BingNews.Prov0
data.value: Microsoft News is a consumer news aggregation app provisioned for new users.

data.name: Comp.BingNews.Prov1
data.value: Optional to remove; no system dependency.

data.name: Comp.BingSearch.Short
data.value: The Windows Search / Bing app used by Start and taskbar search.

data.name: Comp.BingSearch.Long
data.value: Provides web results inside Windows Search. Local file/settings search is a separate OS service and continues to work after removal; only the web layer is affected.

data.name: Comp.BingSearch.KeepIf
data.value: You rely on web results inside Windows Search.

data.name: Comp.BingSearch.RemoveIf
data.value: You only search local files and settings.

data.name: Comp.BingSearch.Impact
data.value: Web results disappear from Windows Search; local search is unaffected.

data.name: Comp.BingSearch.Prov0
data.value: Bing Search provides web results inside the Windows Search experience.

data.name: Comp.BingSearch.Prov1
data.value: Optional to remove; local search continues to work.

data.name: Comp.Calculator.Long
data.value: A widely used utility. Removal is possible but many users expect it; keep unless you replace it with another calculator.

data.name: Comp.Calculator.KeepIf
data.value: You use the built-in Calculator regularly.

data.name: Comp.Calculator.RemoveIf
data.value: You use a different calculator app.

data.name: Comp.Calculator.Impact
data.value: The Calculator app is removed. No OS function depends on it.

data.name: Comp.Calculator.Prov0
data.value: Calculator is a built-in utility app used by many users.

data.name: Comp.Calculator.Prov1
data.value: Usually keep; removal is safe but unexpected by many users.

data.name: Comp.Notepad.Long
data.value: A long-standing utility many users and scripts rely on. Keep unless replaced.

data.name: Comp.Notepad.KeepIf
data.value: You or your scripts use Notepad.

data.name: Comp.Notepad.RemoveIf
data.value: You use another text editor exclusively.

data.name: Comp.Notepad.Impact
data.value: Notepad is removed. Many users and tools expect it.

data.name: Comp.Notepad.Prov0
data.value: Notepad is a built-in plain-text editor relied on by users and scripts.

data.name: Comp.Notepad.Prov1
data.value: Usually keep; removal is safe but widely unexpected.

data.name: Comp.Paint.Long
data.value: A familiar drawing tool. Optional: alternatives (Paint.NET, Photos) exist; removal only affects the app itself.

data.name: Comp.Paint.KeepIf
data.value: You use Paint for quick image edits.

data.name: Comp.Paint.Impact
data.value: Paint is removed. Image files remain and open via other apps.

data.name: Comp.Paint.Prov0
data.value: Paint is a classic raster graphics editor included with Windows.

data.name: Comp.Terminal.Long
data.value: Preferred terminal for developers and IT. Keep unless you use another; removal is safe but inconvenient for power users.

data.name: Comp.Terminal.KeepIf
data.value: You use Windows Terminal for command-line work.

data.name: Comp.Terminal.Impact
data.value: Windows Terminal is removed; classic Console Host still works.

data.name: Comp.Terminal.Prov0
data.value: Windows Terminal is the modern multi-tab terminal for Windows.

data.name: Comp.ToDo.Long
data.value: A consumer productivity app. Optional; no Windows feature depends on it.

data.name: Comp.ToDo.KeepIf
data.value: You manage tasks in Microsoft To Do.

data.name: Comp.ToDo.Impact
data.value: Microsoft To Do is removed. Web/phone versions still work.

data.name: Comp.ToDo.Prov0
data.value: Microsoft To Do is a consumer task-management app.

data.name: Comp.ToDo.Prov1
data.value: Optional to remove; no system dependency.

data.name: Comp.QuickAssist.Short
data.value: Microsoft's app for giving/receiving remote help.

data.name: Comp.QuickAssist.Long
data.value: Lets a helper view and control the screen to assist. Optional; not required for normal use or for standard Remote Desktop.

data.name: Comp.QuickAssist.KeepIf
data.value: You (or help desk) use Quick Assist for remote help.

data.name: Comp.QuickAssist.Impact
data.value: Quick Assist is removed. Standard Remote Desktop is unaffected.

data.name: Comp.QuickAssist.Prov0
data.value: Quick Assist provides view/control screen sharing for remote help.

data.name: Comp.QuickAssist.Prov1
data.value: Optional to remove; not required for normal use.

data.name: Comp.DesktopAppInstaller.Short
data.value: Provides the winget package manager and .msix/.appx installer.

data.name: Comp.DesktopAppInstaller.Long
data.value: Hosts winget and the AppX/MSIX installer. Removing it breaks package management and Store-based installs; treat as Conditional and keep unless you have a reason.

data.name: Comp.DesktopAppInstaller.KeepIf
data.value: You use winget or install .msix/.appx packages.

data.name: Comp.DesktopAppInstaller.RemoveIf
data.value: You never use winget or sideloaded packages.

data.name: Comp.DesktopAppInstaller.Impact
data.value: winget and AppX/MSIX install are unavailable; some installs break.

data.name: Comp.DesktopAppInstaller.Prov0
data.value: App Installer provides the winget package manager and MSIX/AppX installer.

data.name: Comp.DesktopAppInstaller.Prov1
data.value: Usually keep; removal breaks package management.

data.name: Feat.HypervisorPlatform.Short

data.name: Feat.MediaPlayer.Short

data.name: Feat.ScanManagement.Short

data.name: Feat.VirtualMachinePlatform.Short
data.value: Shared virtualization platform used by WSL2, Sandbox and Android apps

data.name: Feat.WindowsSandbox.Short
data.value: Disposable isolated desktop for testing untrusted software

data.name: Feat.Wsl.Short
data.value: Run a Linux environment inside Windows (Windows Subsystem for Linux)

data.name: Opt.Services.XblAuthManager.Short
